leffs.what: attract lamp show (captured as lampfx_001); leaves the start-button lamps out of its layer

ram_read.name: start_button_lamp
ram_read.meaning: lamp number of the START button; ROM-initialised to 65 (file 0x36f64)

ram_read.name: extra_button_lamp
ram_read.meaning: a lamp number left visible by the attract/tilt layers; 0 at power-up (file 0x3908c), set at run time (inferred: a third button lamp)

pseudo: layer = lamp_layer_create(0, 1); mask all lamps; unmask lamps in 0x3908c, 0x36f64 (65), 0x36f65 (66)
fill the 15 groups of table 0x040d2f00 one step at a time; spawn leff_001_chase_task (rotates the 15 groups every 5 ticks)
30 x sleep 62; then group_flash_task: 3 x 8 groups of 0x040d2f38 flash 16 x (3 on/3 off) with tube shows of 0x040d2f3a
blink cycles: blink time 24 -> 4, then 10 x 4, then 5 x 12
leffs.note: Deterministic apart from the lamp numbers in RAM; the exported show is usable if the start lamps are left to their own rule.

leffs.what: bonus count: the 9 bonus-item lamps show which items were collected; GI off

pseudo: for i in 0..8: L = FUN_01015f60(i) (item lamp, table 0x040d2dd0); if bonus_insert_mask & bonus_item_mask(i) == 0: lamp on (mask set) else mask clear

if dmb_lit_mask & rec.mask: mask rec.group; group on if on else off

leffs.what: Recognizer target lamps for the current player: disabled targets solid, the lit (double) target blinks, the previous lit target plane 1 only, others off

ram_read.name: rec_lit_pos
ram_read.meaning: index 0-3 of the currently lit (double-value) target; order 0=L,1=C,2=R,3=C

ram_read.name: rec_prev_pos
ram_read.meaning: previous lit index, still worth +2 for the first 10 ticks after a step

ram_read.name: rec_targets_disabled_mask
ram_read.meaning: [player-1]; bit0=L(sw49) bit1=C(sw50) bit2=R(sw51) set for target switches the OS has disabled (switch errors); recomputed at battle end and battle start; disabled targets lamp solid and are skipped by the moving lit target

pseudo: forever: seen = 0; for i in 0..3 (table 0x040d32b4: {u8 bit, .., .., u8 lamp}):
if rec_targets_disabled_mask[current_player] (byte 0x21117b7 + player, player 1-4) & bit: lamp on (solid)
elif bit == table[rec_lit_pos].bit: lamp on if blink else off
elif bit == table[rec_prev_pos].bit: lamp plane 2 off, plane 1 on

leffs.what: combo arrows: lit combo shots blink, rate from combo_timer while the combo window (task 0xcd) runs

ram_read.name: combo_starters
ram_read.meaning: 0x36: shots that may open a window

ram_read.name: combo_lit
ram_read.meaning: shot masks that combo now

ram_read.name: combo_timer
ram_read.meaning: 312 at open, -7 per 7 ticks

pseudo: for i in 0..5 (table 0x040d2324, 6 bytes: u32 mask, u16 group):
if window and combo_lit & mask: mask group; on if blink else off
elif window or starters: unmask group (combo_starters & mask with no window also unmasks)
sleep window ? max(2, combo_timer < 312 ? combo_timer/31 : 10) : 6; blink = !blink

leffs.what: Portal multiball shot lamps by phase: 0 = per-shot progress bars (count from RAM via table pointers), 1 = group 95 drains/fills, 2 = all shot groups blink

ram_read.name: pm_phase
ram_read.meaning: 0 = collect shots, 1 = super jackpot lit at disc, 2 = all shots 1,000,000

pseudo: forever: if pm_phase == 1: unmask the 7 groups of table 0x040d6e18; mask group 95;
drain group 95 one lamp per 8 ticks until empty, then fill one per 8 ticks until full
elif pm_phase == 0: mask+on group 95; for each of 7 records {u16 group, u8* count}:
n = *count; lamps [0..n) on, lamp n blinks, the rest off
elif pm_phase == 2: mask+on group 95; every record group on/off with blink
